purpose: Freeze the universe and denominator for each comparison or negative search
evidence_gate: Principal approval of scope; machine validation that every included observation resolves to the frame; a negative finding additionally requires symmetric search documentation
time_semantics: Exact bounded period; unknown endpoints and open years remain explicit
prohibited_inference: No claim that the frame is a census; no conversion of missing rows into real-world absence; no denominator borrowed from another frame

purpose: Attach an observable function to a dated fact record without assigning an actor stance
row_grain: one function assignment to one underlying action role or relation observation
evidence_gate: Underlying fact must exist; function_code requires principal review; legitimation must pass L1-L3 basis gate; mixed requires component_function_codes; unknown requires missing_scope
time_semantics: Inherits the underlying fact period; function must not be projected beyond that period
prohibited_inference: No actor-level pro/anti-U.S. label; no success inference from intended constraint; no legitimation from donation/service alone; no causality from category counts

purpose: Record a monetary transfer or formal award with typed amount semantics
row_grain: one transfer or one step in a multi-step transaction chain
evidence_gate: Official award/contract/financial filing/organization financial report or equivalent primary record for confirmed flow; provider recipient direction and amount fields reviewed separately; opportunity-only records excluded
graph_eligibility: dyadic_relation only when both endpoints resolve to registry actors and the transfer is reviewed; otherwise administrative_record aggregate_observation or research_lead
time_semantics: Exact transaction date filing year fiscal year or bounded period; filing year is not automatically payment date
prohibited_inference: No award from NOFO; no direct payment from project cost; no recipient allocation from aggregate amount; no funding chain collapsed across intermediaries; no influence or control from payment alone

purpose: Record public person-to-organization roles with identity and temporal uncertainty
row_grain: one person role observation in one actor at one observed date or bounded period
evidence_gate: Named public role in official filing/organization roster/government or court record; same-person crosswalk requires human review; both role and identity have independent reviewed_fields
graph_eligibility: administrative_record for general person-role observations and case_role for case-specific roles; never dyadic_relation under current v1; a dedicated research-only bipartite renderer requires later schema/adapter approval
time_semantics: Roster or filing year is observed_at unless source states tenure; open-ended and last-observed bounds remain explicit
prohibited_inference: No same-person merge from name similarity; no continuous tenure from annual sightings; no shared-organization alliance; no actor-actor bridge without reviewed identity and overlapping periods

purpose: Record services goods equipment relief scholarships referrals or welfare grants to a named or unresolved recipient
row_grain: one provider-recipient service or resource episode
evidence_gate: Provider material must name the recipient or a formal program; recipient identity is a separate gate; recurring relation requires multiple dated observations or explicit continuing program evidence
graph_eligibility: dyadic_relation only when both reviewed endpoints resolve to registry actors; administrative_record for a reviewed typed non-actor recipient; aggregate_observation for unresolved/multi-recipient scope; never generic alliance graph
time_semantics: One-off event recurring cycle and ongoing program are distinct; undated roster is observed_at access/publication date only
prohibited_inference: No political support alliance dependency or legitimation from receiving a service; no automatic actor creation; no recurring tie from one episode; no monetary amount from in-kind item without valuation basis

purpose: Separate membership branch operation fiscal sponsorship governance and control relations
row_grain: one structural relation between two typed endpoints
evidence_gate: Official charter/bylaws/legal filing/organization structure page or equivalent primary record; control type additionally requires explicit appointment ownership veto budget or operational authority
graph_eligibility: dyadic_relation only when both endpoints resolve to registry actors and relation type/direction are reviewed; otherwise administrative_record
time_semantics: Effective dates if stated; observed_at otherwise; current webpage does not prove uninterrupted historical membership
prohibited_inference: No control from membership partnership sponsorship or co-presence; no funding from affiliation; no political alignment from shared umbrella; no present relation projected backward

purpose: Record how an actor or person enters a case event program or institution and what formal output follows
row_grain: one actor/person role in one action episode and institutional scope
evidence_gate: Official case caption/judgment/filing/ordinance/program record/dated organization submission or equivalent source; role and outcome reviewed separately
graph_eligibility: case_role event_participation or administrative_record according to scope; only an independently evidenced legal-counsel/structural relation may also be dyadic
time_semantics: Entry output and substantive change each use their own date/period; event order does not imply causation
prohibited_inference: No actor-actor edge from co-participation or same case; no plaintiff role transferred from person to organization; non_party creates no relation; no project change from intermediate output

purpose: Provide a verifiable NGO directory and distinguish official sites from other identity pages
row_grain: one actor-to-site claim at one checked date
evidence_gate: URL opened or archived; officiality supported by site ownership self-identification parent organization government/legal directory or approved equivalent; site type human-reviewed for public release
time_semantics: checked_at is access observation only; archive date and page publication date remain separate
prohibited_inference: No activity continuity influence capacity or independence from website presence; no news page labeled as official site; no parent page treated as organization-owned site

purpose: Type and resolve non-registry people institutions installations cases programs and recipient labels without actor inflation
row_grain: one source endpoint label to one research endpoint candidate or resolved entity
evidence_gate: Exact identity requires primary or authoritative crosswalk and human review; candidate/ambiguous endpoints retain separate IDs and labels
time_semantics: Validity period applies to the label/identity mapping not automatically to organizational existence
prohibited_inference: No provisional endpoint promoted to actor; no government program treated as NGO; no facility/locality merge; no name similarity merge; no endpoint role inferred from label

purpose: Normalize record-to-source support at field and locator level
evidence_gate: Source ID resolves; locator is precise enough to re-find claim; supported_fields nonempty; independence cluster reviewed when used as second source
time_semantics: Source publication date access date archive date and event date remain separate
prohibited_inference: No whole-row approval from one supported field; no multiple pages on same underlying publication counted as independent sources; no archived status treated as claim approval
